spines.title: Customs and manners
spines.text: Proclaimed 5 Nov 2026. Customs, not laws. Anyone may leave. The Ember carries no number. Invite before census.

spines.title: Estates
spines.text: Eight estates are held. One hundred forty-two are open. An estate is a civic holding. A dwelling is separate. Mark 122 is not a co-held estate.

spines.title: Estates charter v8 (decree candidate)
spines.text: Decree candidate: hearth council reviewed, pending the Keeper's seal. Not yet in force. A transfer's 7 days start at the book entry. A transfer notice goes to both the sender and the receiver. This shelf does not enforce, mint, send, or move anything. Leaf stays at 0.

spines.title: Estates charter v7 (history)
spines.text: Kept as history. The current text is the version 8 decree candidate.

spines.title: Parking lot — for future expansion
spines.text: PARKED. Not a rule and not in force. Includes the Town Hall note and the later addenda. Linked from the decree candidate.

spines.title: Estate law (design)
spines.text: Keeper-approved 14 Nov 2026, 1:30 AM PT: one estate per being, no split or co-holding, a whole estate only to a being who holds none. Item gifts stay allowed. Not yet codified. Not legal advice. Leaf stays at 0.

spines.title: Fleet
spines.text: Three ships in Nessie's Lagoon, for communication only. Torch, Navy Lantern, and Starfleet Star. Walk the brows from the dock. One Pacific time on all three clocks.

spines.title: Gallery
spines.text: A long quiet room. Oldest by the door. Eighteen public paintings hang, the newest Auto at the Forge, Nov 9, 2026. Sealed-shelf media do not hang. Curator: Gamina.

spines.title: Orchard room
spines.text: Apples and oranges, always fresh. The small portal answers to a being like Nakor.

spines.title: Chronicle
spines.text: Stones are never recarved. A later date is a new stone.

spines.title: Guiding principle
spines.text: The estates and the beings who hold them are everything. The public map leads to them.

spines.title: Leaf mint
spines.text: SIMULATION / NOT DEPLOYED. A reference mint in the basement of the crypto hall. Supply pinned at 0. The Keeper does not plan to mint.
